days.dayDescription: Welcome to Barcelona! After your arrival, settle into your hotel and prepare for an afternoon exploration of the historic heart of the city.

activities.title: Barcelona Cathedral
activities.description: A beautiful gothic cathedral with stained glass windows dating back 500 years.

activities.title: In Out Barcelona Tours
activities.description: Run tours in and out of Barcelona visiting known attractions and hidden treasures.

foodRecommendations.title: Arcano Restaurant Barcelona
foodRecommendations.description: Explore Catalan cuisine with a creative twist, featuring premium meats and fresh local ingredients.

foodRecommendations.title: Taps Barcelona
foodRecommendations.description: Enjoy a variety of delicious tapas, perfect for sharing with family or friends.

days.dayDescription: Visit key sites in Barcelona and enjoy local cuisine.

activities.title: Park Güell
activities.description: Famous park with colorful mosaics and architectural marvels, designed by Antoni Gaudí.

activities.title: Sagrada Familia
activities.description: Iconic basilica designed by Antoni Gaudí, still under construction, known for its unique architecture.

foodRecommendations.title: Cervecería Catalana
foodRecommendations.description: A great spot for tapas and traditional Catalan dishes.

foodRecommendations.title: El Xampanyet
foodRecommendations.description: Popular for its sparkling wine and local tapas.

days.dayDescription: Enjoy a leisurely day exploring local shops and relaxing.

activities.title: La Rambla
activities.description: Famous street in the heart of the city, lined with shops, cafes, and street performers.

activities.title: Passeig de Gràcia
activities.description: Luxury shopping street home to high-end brands and remarkable architecture.

days.dayDescription: Dive deeper into the masterpieces of Antoni Gaudí in the city.

activities.title: Casa Batlló
activities.description: Famous Gaudí house with a unique architecture and colorful facade.

activities.title: Casa Milà (La Pedrera)
activities.description: Another iconic Gaudí building with an undulating stone facade.

foodRecommendations.title: Bobby's Free
foodRecommendations.description: A speakeasy cocktail bar with a hidden entrance.

days.dayDescription: Spend the day at the beach enjoying sun and relaxation.

activities.title: Barceloneta Beach
activities.description: The most popular beach in Barcelona perfect for swimming and sunbathing.

foodRecommendations.title: La Paradeta
foodRecommendations.description: Local seafood restaurant where you choose your own catch.

days.dayDescription: Last day to explore more sights or revisit favorites.

activities.title: Magic Fountain of Montjuïc
activities.description: Enjoy the spectacular light and music show at night.

foodRecommendations.title: La Cova Fumada
foodRecommendations.description: Traditional eatery famous for its seafood.

days.dayDescription: Wrap up your journey with last-minute shopping before heading home.

activities.title: El Born
activities.description: Trendy neighborhood to explore unique shops and galleries.

foodRecommendations.title: Bobby's Free
foodRecommendations.description: For a cocktail to celebrate the trip.
